To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the KORA models for prediction of 7-year incident diabetes in the older adults were externally validated in a Dutch population, with similar discrimination and good calibration after adjustment for the intercept of each model.
the KORA S3/F3 models for the risk prediction of type 2 diabetes (T2DM), developed in the German population, showed good performance in an independent Dutch population.

we validated the KORA S 4/ F 4 prediction models for type-2 diabetes mellitus in older adults (≥55 years) in a Dutch population and that we found that the models performed well with respect to discrimination, but that the calibration needs to be corrected to obtain a good performance in a different setting.
In summary, our research is concerned with
external validation of prediction models for type II diabetes mellitus (DM) in older people.
the external validation of the Kora models for the prediction of T2D in older adults.
external validation of the Kora models in an older Dutch cohort.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the models can be used for discrimination, but not for risk estimation.
the KORA clinical model can be used to identify older Dutch adults at risk of T2D, but the models should be adjusted to account for the different intercept and slope in a different setting.

the KORA S3/F4 prediction models are not yet suitable to be used in other populations, but that the models can serve as an excellent starting point for further development of a prediction model in other populations.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the KORA S3/F3 model can be used to predict the risk of developing T2DM in a different population.
the KORA S 4/F 4 clinical models for prediction for T 2D M in an older population are applicable in a different population.
the KORA models are valid in an older population with good discrimination but poor calibration.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the KORA models are applicable in other settings.
the KORA S-4 F-4 prediction model can be used in a different population, but it requires some adjustments to be made.
the prediction models developed in the Kora S4/F4 cohort for the risk of T2D in older adults are externally valid and applicable in the Dutch population.
